allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.

facts.overview: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.
facts.title: Below Zero

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Cut off in the freezing dark with threats on both sides of the reinforced steel, who orchestrates the assault, and who will outlast the night?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: During a routine transport in Spain, an armored prisoner van is ambushed on a desolate road. Trapped with volatile inmates, the officer in charge must fend off external assailants while surviving sub-zero cold.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, suspenseful, and frostbitten, pairing intense multi-sided danger with engaged, high-tension energy ideal for solo or group viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Lluís Quílez delivers a relentless, pressure-cooker Spanish thriller where ruthless human hostility collides with brutal freezing elements in a fast-paced battle for survival.

issueSummaries: description: 'armored prisoner van' and 'ambushed on a desolate road' add unsupported concrete attributes — the authorized overview states only that a 'prisoner transfer van' was attacked, with no specification of the van's armor or the road/location as desolate.

description: 'volatile inmates' attributes a specific character trait to the inmates that is not established by the overview, which only states the cop must fight 'those inside and outside' without characterizing them.

curiosityHook: 'freezing dark' and 'outlast the night' assert a nighttime setting that is not established anywhere in the authorized overview, which specifies only 'icy temperatures' with no reference to time of day.
curiosityHook: 'reinforced steel' concretizes the van's construction material, a specific factual attribute not present in the overview.
claudeAdvisory.sourceBoundaryReason: Per A_PRIME_PRODUCTION_MATERIALITY_V1, minor atmospheric inference is tolerated, but concretizing specific factual attributes not established by the source — a night/dark setting, a desolate road, an armored/reinforced vehicle, and a 'volatile' inmate characterization — cumulatively specify locations, timing, and factual attributes the closed-world packet does not establish. These are decision-relevant viewer expectations (e.g., a viewer might expect a night-set siege that the film may not actually depict) rather than harmless stylistic variation. None of these rise to plot-mechanic invention, causal fabrication, or spoiler-boundary violation, so MINOR is appropriate rather than SEVERE.

sourceEvidence.notes: Overview supports: a prisoner transfer van is attacked; the cop in charge must fight people inside and outside the van while contending with icy temperatures. This grounds the core premise across all four fields.

No detail establishes the van as 'armored,' the road as 'desolate,' the inmates as 'volatile,' the van's material as 'reinforced steel,' or the setting as nighttime ('freezing dark'/'the night'). These are unsupported concretizations of location, vehicle attributes, character traits, and time of day.
whyWatch correctly attributes direction to Lluís Quílez (facts.director) and situates the film as a Spanish thriller, consistent with facts.countries and facts.genres.

vibeSummary's 'fast, suspenseful... engaged, high-tension energy... solo or group viewing' directly reflects the authorized pace (fast), moods (suspenseful, exciting), attentionDemand (engaged), and situations (alone, friends) classifications.
